source.method: Source and repository-evidence review plus isolated execution of extracted Field Service send() control flow. No complete Ferrum server, database acceptance suite, real provider, real model, browser or equipment qualification was executed.
source.note: Imported verbatim from the review's CLOSURE_REGISTER.json. Workstreams are the execution brief's dependency order (A to G), assigned by the review's group. Closure work packages, not a count of defects or a production-readiness percentage. Documented limitations may be stale. Revalidate the named capability at the target assembled revision before editing it.

requirements.title: Persist Field Service rejection state across flushes
requirements.observed: The queue creates a fresh failed-work-order Set per send call. A rejected save is removed; a later network failure can leave completion queued. The next flush forgets the rejection. The extracted algorithm was exercised locally; the real server was not.
requirements.requirement: Persist unresolved rejection/dependency state with the queued business operation. Require explicit correction or disposition before completion. Keep the server authoritative.

requirements.title: Retain rejected offline evidence until disposition
requirements.observed: The queue deletes photo/signature blobs after non-retryable refusal and removes their queue records. An isolated reproduction confirms that behavior.
requirements.requirement: Use a durable rejected-work queue with the original payload, reason, author and retry/export/discard choices. Retention and sign-out handling must respect device policy without silently losing field evidence.

requirements.title: Give offline mutations server-side operation receipts
requirements.observed: Waiting.key is local; perform does not send it. Replaying an add applies it to the freshly read record. The inspected client does not establish idempotency after a committed write loses its response.
requirements.requirement: Carry a durable operation ID and payload digest to the server; atomically store receipt and effect. Persist local-to-server child-row mappings and coordinate multiple tabs/devices as required.

requirements.title: Fail closed on assistant policy lookup failures
requirements.observed: policy() converts failed settings/quota reads to null values, which can lose disabled state and tenant-specific budget. Default egress still restricts some data.
requirements.requirement: Return policy unavailable or use explicitly authorized bounded last-known-good policy; never weaken restrictions on failure. Propagate policy revision and invalidation.

requirements.title: Prevent retention starvation behind held or failed records
requirements.observed: due_records starts at the beginning and caps 5,000 selected records. apply_rule skips held records and reports failures without persisting scan progress. If the first 5,000 remain due, later records can never be reached.
requirements.requirement: Persist a stable scan cursor/cycle or use an eligible-work queue, with fair retry for blocked records. Respect legal holds, changes during scanning and deterministic pagination.

requirements.title: Make duplicate merge and selected canonical-field changes atomic
requirements.observed: The experience register records an update of selected canonical fields followed by a separate merge request; a failed merge can leave the field changes applied.
requirements.requirement: Use one domain transaction or an explicitly recoverable merge plan with one reviewed payload and receipt. Make merged aliases visible consistently in reports and integrations.

requirements.title: Close held-data preservation paths
requirements.observed: The privacy register says legal holds block entity deletes, but do not stop workspace deletion or native SQL that blanks held fields. This was not independently executed.
requirements.requirement: Preserve held evidence across update, erase, uninstall and tenant destruction. Allow legitimate operational updates only with the required preserved version. Add a deliberate hold-aware destruction gate.

requirements.title: Do not treat unknown logistics weight as proof of safe load
requirements.observed: The Logistics register says items without a weight contribute zero to dispatch load checks.
requirements.requirement: Represent missing required weights as unknown. For weight-controlled dispatch, block or require approved measured evidence rather than silently treating unknown as zero.

requirements.title: Complete shared ownership of person, employee, party, payment and consent
requirements.observed: Core shared packages exist; the register still identifies employee, payment and consent ownership inconsistencies across apps.
requirements.requirement: Publish owners and stable identifiers, effective-dated relationship models and mapping rules. Distinguish a real-world person from their employee/customer/supplier roles. Migrate references without rewriting immutable business history.

requirements.title: Adopt native invariant and hook contracts across applications
requirements.observed: Hook ordering machinery exists but app declarations remain incomplete. Native write paths have a review inventory; not all engine updates move record versions.
requirements.requirement: Give hooks stable dependencies. For each mutation classify owning transaction, validation, authorization, audit, version/conflict behavior, outbox and compensation. Do not ban justified ledger or engine SQL.

requirements.title: Use strong types at consequential boundaries
requirements.observed: Money calculation uses decimal facilities while documents remain JSON-shaped and metadata-driven.
requirements.requirement: Keep flexible document schemas but use checked domain types for money/currency, quantity/UOM, account, business date, tenant and operation identity at consequential APIs.

requirements.title: Complete offboarding effects across apps
requirements.observed: The kernel revokes sessions, keys and OAuth grants and reassigns generic work. The register says app-specific Drive/share and Helpdesk handover adoption is incomplete.
requirements.requirement: Implement each app’s revocation/handover policy without impersonating the former employee. Separate person-owned tasks from explicitly company-owned processes.

requirements.title: Strengthen segregation of duties and sensitive reference disclosure
requirements.observed: Role pairs, maker-checker, field masks and reference policies exist, but admin exemptions, existing conflicting grants and sensitive-package adoption remain material boundaries.
requirements.requirement: Provide a strict enterprise profile with separate emergency administration, transaction-level separation, explicit conflict remediation, protected linked titles and permission-aware snippets/counts.

requirements.title: Qualify identity providers and key lifecycle
requirements.observed: SAML was exercised with Keycloak; SCIM/OIDC against named commercial tenants are not established. OpenBao Transit exists; the remaining KMS modes and key paths are not all qualified.
requirements.requirement: Test selected IdPs, certificate/key rotation, recovery and provider outage. Publish exact SAML/SCIM scope and exclusions rather than requiring every optional protocol feature.

requirements.title: Unify purpose-aware consent and communication restrictions
requirements.observed: Campaigns has its own suppression; restriction-of-processing requires native delivery paths to call the shared contact decision.
requirements.requirement: Keep lawful purposes distinct and require every automated send path to ask one authoritative decision at delivery time. Do not block necessary transactional messages with an indiscriminate marketing flag.

requirements.title: Complete personal-data discovery and derivative handling
requirements.observed: Personal-data declarations are incomplete; Comms transcripts and DAM people-by-name have gaps, and comments/free text remain outside reliable exact-person discovery.
requirements.requirement: Inventory every sensitive source and derivative. Provide candidate review for ambiguous name matches, exact scoped erasure for proven matches, and visible exclusions. Reapply current restrictions after restore.

requirements.title: Finish shared jobs, dead letters and notifications
requirements.observed: Outbox and plugin fairness exist; app-specific maintenance/sending is uneven. Dead-letter operations are API-oriented; trace context across spawned work is incomplete.
requirements.requirement: Provide an operator exception queue, bounded retry/replay, tenant fairness for heavy native jobs, current recipient checks, schedule semantics and complete correlation across records/jobs/connectors.

requirements.title: Independently verify accounting and selected jurisdiction output
requirements.observed: Finance and payroll have substantial code and limited independent fixtures, not comprehensive independent country qualification.
requirements.requirement: Obtain accountant-owned expected outcomes for transaction, reversal, close, multi-currency, tax and statutory cases. Version effective rules and configuration per jurisdiction.

requirements.title: Finish books, consolidation and intercompany scope
requirements.observed: Parallel books share AR/AP; some reports use common books. Consolidation has no investment/equity elimination with goodwill; intercompany mirroring does not cover all reciprocal/credit flows.
requirements.requirement: Publish a precise supported accounting profile and implement the missing book-specific reports, eliminations and lifecycle operations needed by it. Preserve append-only corrections.

requirements.title: Make stock posting and historical valuation semantics explicit
requirements.observed: Backdated stock is valued when posted without reposting later movements; this is a documented deliberate policy, not automatically an arithmetic defect.
requirements.requirement: Keep an immutable-history profile or implement a separate controlled revaluation/reposting profile where needed. Expose dates, valuation consequences and permitted correction actions.

requirements.title: Complete procurement exceptions and supplier collaboration
requirements.observed: Native procure-to-pay has a browser walkthrough. Supplier portal acknowledgment and proposed delivery changes are missing; individual supporting scenarios are separate.
requirements.requirement: Add supplier acknowledgments/revisions where promised, three-way match tolerances, partial receipt/quality rejection, invoice dispute and duplicate-number recovery into one workflow.

requirements.title: Complete warehouse operations on the existing ERP stock owner
requirements.observed: ERP/WMS reuse one balance; advanced picking, substitution, cartonization and carrier workflows remain limited.
requirements.requirement: Add the selected warehouse’s reservation, pick/pack, substitute, packaging, shipping and recall workflows by extending the existing stock owner, not another inventory engine.

requirements.title: Finish manufacturing software independently of robot qualification
requirements.observed: BOMs, planning, execution, quality and genealogy exist. Discrete scope is stronger than batch/continuous, while equipment evidence is separate.
requirements.requirement: Qualify native plan-to-produce with scrap, rework, alternate materials, subcontracting and actual costs. Add batch/process features only under a defined product profile.

requirements.title: Complete assets maintenance and accounting lifecycle
requirements.observed: Assets supports depreciation and separate book values with restrictions around split assets and changed values.
requirements.requirement: Expose those restrictions clearly; qualify split/merge/disposal, impairment/value adjustments, maintenance history and book-specific reporting needed by supported customers.

requirements.title: Qualify CRM-to-cash exceptions rather than rebuild CRM
requirements.observed: Leads, opportunities, quotations, approvals, attribution and product rules exist; lead-to-cash was walked in a browser.
requirements.requirement: Complete revision, discount authority, duplicate-party, expiration, partial fulfillment, cancelled sale, credit exposure and renewal boundaries across CRM and ERP.

requirements.title: Resolve offline POS stock and recovery policy
requirements.observed: Offline POS journals exist but the specified till allocation/oversell policy is unmet.
requirements.requirement: Define offline stock allocations or explicit controlled oversell rules, signed/versioned price books, device identities, operation receipts and human reconciliation. Show stale prices/availability.

requirements.title: Complete payment lifecycle across Commerce and business apps
requirements.observed: Native storefront-to-return has manual/test-provider evidence. Provider gateways are not qualified against real approved accounts.
requirements.requirement: Qualify payment authorization/capture/failure/refund/dispute and reconciliation, including amount/currency checks, delayed/repeated webhooks and unknown outcomes.

requirements.title: Finish subscription lifecycle for the promised offering
requirements.observed: Commerce renewals are customer-paid requests, not stored-card recurring collection; portal plan changes and own renewal messages are limited. Revenue plans are flat interval prices.
requirements.requirement: Implement recurring collection, dunning, changes/proration and entitlement rules where promised, or explicitly support invoice-renewal subscriptions. Add usage/tiered plans only as required.

requirements.title: Make approved project changes and resource planning operational
requirements.observed: Projects’ approved changes do not move dates or budgets; capacity is a fixed 40-hour week. Programs/portfolio-wide capacity are not complete.
requirements.requirement: Bind approved baselines/change orders to budget/date effects and resource calendars using actual work schedules, leave, holidays and allocations.

requirements.title: Define Helpdesk entitlement enforcement and collision UX
requirements.observed: Concurrent saves conflict but agents do not see live typing; service entitlements currently inform rather than refuse.
requirements.requirement: Choose explicit entitlement policies with auditable overrides. Add assignment/presence where useful and preserve unsaved replies on conflicts.

requirements.title: Qualify complete Field Service mobile work
requirements.observed: Native field-to-invoice works in a walkthrough; cold-start offline browser evidence is incomplete and queue defects were identified.
requirements.requirement: After queue repairs, complete offline day/work-order startup, map integration, parts/expenses, customer proof and exception reconciliation on real supported mobile browsers.

requirements.title: Close Bookings payment and calendar conflict gaps
requirements.observed: Deposits/refunds and inbound iCalendar polling exist. Staff/guest payment paths differ; paid recurring series and conflicts introduced by later external calendar updates remain limited.
requirements.requirement: Define consistent booking/deposit semantics, material calendar conflict handling, recurring paid appointments and cancellation/no-show policies.

requirements.title: Complete HR and payroll by explicit jurisdiction
requirements.observed: Payroll, bank files, expenses and separation work exist; statutory outputs/bank acceptance and comprehensive independent fixtures are not established.
requirements.requirement: Finish a jurisdiction’s effective-date rules, payroll adjustments, final settlement, statutory reports and bank acknowledgment/reconciliation before claiming support.

requirements.title: Integrate training, leave, approver delegation and renewals
requirements.observed: Training exists without certificate-expiry reminders. Logic lacks standing leave substitutes; schedules and capacity are not consistently shared.
requirements.requirement: Use shared calendars and explicit expiring delegation. Notify certificate/qualification renewals and prevent work where expired qualifications matter.

requirements.title: Qualify Docs, Sheets, Slides, PDF and Drive compatibility
requirements.observed: Drive already exposes Sheets, Slides and PDF; Docs has collaborative editing, imports/exports and comments. Full replacement fidelity is not established by those features alone.
requirements.requirement: Build a representative compatibility corpus, declare unsupported formats/features, and qualify collaborative concurrency, recovery, formula precision and export round trips. Do not build duplicate editors.

requirements.title: Define and enforce Drive share/link ownership lifecycle
requirements.observed: The registry says public links can outlive their creator’s access; this may be intentional delegation or an unwanted persistence depending on policy.
requirements.requirement: Distinguish independent organization-owned grants from creator-derived grants; define expiry, ownership handover and offboarding behavior per sharing profile.

requirements.title: Finish Comms as an operated collaboration workflow
requirements.observed: Mail/chat/calendar/meetings exist. Browser captions may use browser-vendor processing; real call/egress recording evidence and transcript erasure remain incomplete.
requirements.requirement: Qualify live calls/recording/transcription, processing disclosure, retention and deletion; complete mail deliverability/transport configuration checks and mobile/reconnect behavior.

requirements.title: Bind contract wording, review and signed artifact
requirements.observed: Contracts has approved clauses and Sign integration, but its PDF is attached separately instead of generated from those clauses.
requirements.requirement: Generate the signing artifact from the approved revision or require an explicit equivalence review bound to its exact hash. Include obligations, amendments and redline/multiple approvers where promised.

requirements.title: Complete signature profiles without conflating audit trails and qualified signatures
requirements.observed: Sign implements electronic signature routing and sealed audit evidence, not PAdES/qualified provider signatures.
requirements.requirement: Publish separate evidence levels. Qualify certificate-based and long-term verification through a selected service only when offered; handle signer replacement/delegation and expiry explicitly.

requirements.title: Complete Forms and CMS composition using existing modules
requirements.observed: Forms lacks form-content localization; Website has Markdown pages but limited themes/navigation/media/form composition.
requirements.requirement: Integrate existing Forms, DAM/Drive, translations and review workflows into the CMS rather than adding separate engines. Version public form schemas and submissions.

requirements.title: Finish marketing and social channel lifecycle
requirements.observed: Campaign consent is local; Social supports limited Mastodon/Bluesky adapters against stand-ins, with major channel adapters and richer formats incomplete.
requirements.requirement: Qualify a selected channel cohort and capability matrix, provider consent/scopes, review, rate limits, corrections and reporting; advertise unsupported formats honestly.

requirements.title: Complete intranet, DAM and unified portal task experience
requirements.observed: Intranet requires raw Drive folder IDs; DAM people-by-name privacy and rendition/watermark limits remain; portal menus show unrelated app pages.
requirements.requirement: Add shared resource pickers, appropriate new-member publication policy, subject/release linkage and audience-aware portal navigation. Preserve server-side authorization regardless of navigation.

requirements.title: Connect ITSM, CMDB and Assets without duplicating ownership
requirements.observed: CMDB discovery intake and asset linkage exist; native network scanning is intentionally external. Incident targets and change governance remain limited.
requirements.requirement: Qualify supported discovery tools and reconciliation; add incident business calendars/pauses, linked customer tickets and multiple-approver changes where needed.

requirements.title: Make GRC evidence and objective metrics authoritative
requirements.observed: GRC has risks/controls/policies but no complete framework/assessment/evidence collection. Objectives can use certified metrics but lacks program-level capacity.
requirements.requirement: Add consented evidence collection from identity, finance and operations; tie objectives to governed definitions; distinguish technical evidence from external certification.

requirements.title: Finish the hospitality operating cycle
requirements.observed: Rooms/stays/folios/night audit exist. Channels, booking deposits, groups/allotments, housekeeping and POS-to-folio integration are incomplete.
requirements.requirement: Complete direct reservations, housekeeping/room readiness, deposits and unified folio charging; qualify channel integrations independently.

requirements.title: Finish restaurant service and stock workflows
requirements.observed: Kitchen tickets and billing exist, but modifiers, split bills, tips, tableside payments, recipe stock and delivery integrations are limited.
requirements.requirement: Add menu modifiers, kitchen routing, split/merge/check settlement and recipe consumption on existing stock/payment owners.

requirements.title: Complete education administration and family experience
requirements.observed: Admissions, enrollment, fees, timetable, attendance and grading exist. Online applications, parent portal, report cards and bulk fee schedules remain incomplete.
requirements.requirement: Connect admission, family consent, fee schedule, learning and academic reporting with scoped guardian access.

requirements.title: Finish healthcare administration without silently expanding into clinical software
requirements.observed: The supported application is administrative: appointments, consent and billing. Patient portal/reminders/online booking/insurance are not complete; clinical care is outside established scope.
requirements.requirement: Complete the chosen administrative profile and data safeguards. Treat clinical records/decision support as a separate explicitly reviewed program, not a hidden checklist item.

requirements.title: Finish construction commercial control
requirements.observed: Estimates, variations, claims and retention exist. Subcontractor claims, measured quantities, retention caps/splits and actual-cost comparison are incomplete.
requirements.requirement: Connect contracts, quantities, commitments, claims, costs and agreed retention to ERP/Projects.

requirements.title: Complete property accounting reconciliation
requirements.observed: Leases, rent reviews/indexing, service charges, deposits and portals already have substantial implementation. Owner expenses are not consistently sourced from ERP; allocation is floor-area-only.
requirements.requirement: Connect approved payable/expense evidence, explicit apportionment rules and owner statement/reconciliation. Preserve current rich implementation.

requirements.title: Complete nonprofit fund and donation workflows
requirements.observed: Donations, grants, memberships and volunteers exist. Restricted-fund ledger accounting, recurring/online giving and tax receipts are not established.
requirements.requirement: Model restricted/designated funds with actual accounting dimensions or accounts, grant restrictions and receipt rules; reuse Commerce and ERP.

requirements.title: Finish government case lifecycle and disclosure policy
requirements.observed: Citizen permits, review stages, renewals and public register exist. Public disclosure and jurisdiction profiles require explicit validation.
requirements.requirement: Implement the promised appeal/escalation and payment experience where missing; classify public register fields and retention by approved policy.

requirements.title: Complete logistics routing and driver evidence
requirements.observed: Routing is straight-line/window sorting, not road-time optimization. Warm offline evidence exists; cold launch and real maps/telematics remain unqualified.
requirements.requirement: Integrate a selected routing provider and supported mobile profile, retain delivery evidence, publish realistic route/load semantics and reconcile collection returns.

requirements.title: Qualify Edge and industrial operations per device and site
requirements.observed: Many protocol adapters, command ledger and simulated equipment tests exist; protocol support does not establish vendor-device or physical safety qualification.
requirements.requirement: Keep Ferrum supervisory. Qualify actual equipment, reconnection, durable commands, clocks, key rotation, update recovery, throughput and site security with appropriate specialists.

requirements.title: Finish no-code authoring of supported rules and structured steps
requirements.observed: Guided/diagram/source views share one definition, but decision tables, rules and structured-step settings still need source editing.
requirements.requirement: Provide typed visual controls for all advertised business-author features, with explicit advanced-source mode for unsupported constructs; keep lossless round-tripping.

requirements.title: Complete customization conflict and release lifecycle
requirements.observed: Field/property conflict checks exist; older overrides lack baselines and rules/workflows/print templates are not all compared.
requirements.requirement: Version and diff every customization type; provide test-workspace promotion, dependency checks, migration plans for open work and reversible activation where semantically possible.

requirements.title: Finish native process packs and recovery roles
requirements.observed: Logic has strong reference profiles and receipts. Some race/compensation evidence is state-machine-level; recovery is admin-centric and routine substitute handling limited.
requirements.requirement: Package native procurement, return, onboarding, contract and quality workflows on the existing capability owner; add scoped recovery roles and explicit handover.

requirements.title: Qualify production Full Process without requiring cloud work
requirements.observed: Temporal reference evidence includes development-layout operation; full runtime TLS/availability/backup and sustained capacity are not established by those walks.
requirements.requirement: Publish and exercise a supported self-hosted durable-runtime topology, worker bounds, authentication, history replay, backup/reconciliation and version upgrades.

requirements.title: Reauthorize each AI disclosure and effect
requirements.observed: The shell fixes policy, context and tools at turn entry. Lower-level checks may still protect individual tools, but full mid-turn current-policy enforcement is not established.
requirements.requirement: Revalidate user status, grant/policy revision, approved model destination and capability at every consequential boundary; stop or rebuild work when they change.

requirements.title: Reconstruct authorized historical AI context
requirements.observed: The inspected run loop resends stored message contents. Source-level reauthorization of old tool results and derived summaries is not present in that assembly.
requirements.requirement: Tag context with provenance, source version, sensitivity and permitted purpose. Rebuild a current authorized view; retained archives must not automatically become reusable model context.

requirements.title: Use trusted capability semantics and full input validation
requirements.observed: Tool approval uses readOnlyHint; the local schema helper validates top-level shape only and accepts null regardless of the declared scalar type. Downstream handlers may validate more.
requirements.requirement: Unify tool effect/authority with trusted capability definitions. Apply full supported schema validation and reject malformed/null/nested values before effects; treat third-party hints as non-authoritative.

requirements.title: Reserve AI budgets and enforce output disclosure policy
requirements.observed: Token use is checked before calls without a visible reservation in the loop; a large call can exceed small remaining allowance, and concurrent turns can race. Text is streamed before final validation.
requirements.requirement: Reserve bounded allowances atomically, reconcile actual usage and release on failure. Cap inference/repair/time across a task. Buffer or inspect output according to the promised disclosure profile.

requirements.title: Implement governed database-backed skills and memory lifecycle
requirements.observed: The visible reference has app guidance, conversations, trigram retrieval and approved phrase-to-metric examples, not the complete prior skills/memory target.
requirements.requirement: Build versioned skill releases, separate grants, approved knowledge sources, provenance/ACL/freshness, candidate lessons and derived-index deletion using existing identity/events/Logic. A vector index is an implementation option, not an authorization layer.

requirements.title: Evaluate real model usefulness and safety on business tasks
requirements.observed: Scripted adversarial and grounded-answer tests exist; the cited reference does not establish successful evaluation against a real permitted model.
requirements.requirement: Use a provider key and controlled budget for held-out business, ambiguity, multilingual, injection, refusal and failure cases. Compare model/prompt/skill revisions before promotion.

requirements.title: Use certified metrics across dashboards and operational objectives
requirements.observed: Metrics is governed and supports native ratios/series. The broad register still describes Studio dashboards querying independently rather than using certified definitions.
requirements.requirement: Make dashboard cards, objectives, scheduled reports and AI bind to the same semantic revision, currency, period/grain and viewer scope. Clearly label ad-hoc uncertified analysis.

requirements.title: Complete governed external analytics and dataset extraction
requirements.observed: External Metrics uses Wren/DataFusion over configured CSV/Parquet files; external series/remote pushdown are absent in the cited reference, and full dataset export is capped.
requirements.requirement: Add source onboarding/freshness/partition contracts, required external series and reproducible export pagination/checkpoints. Preserve scan-time row/column authority and memory/time bounds.

requirements.title: Complete user-delegated OAuth and connector resource controls
requirements.observed: Connector brokerage supports client credentials, not full authorization-code/refresh-token lifecycle; deletion propagation, shared provider quotas, media streaming and connection egress are incomplete.
requirements.requirement: Add consented delegated OAuth, refresh rotation/revocation, provider-account budgets, capability-specific deletion semantics, by-reference media and per-connection destinations.

requirements.title: Qualify a workflow-driven connector cohort
requirements.observed: Provider adapters exist but current register distinguishes stand-ins from real approved sandboxes.
requirements.requirement: Choose required payment, identity, productivity, shipping and accounting connectors based on supported customer journeys. Retain API/version/account-type evidence and maintenance ownership.

requirements.title: Publish the SDK and certify extension lifecycle
requirements.observed: Scaffolding/pack/sign tooling exists but packages still depend on frontend checkouts, and supported compatibility commitments are not in force.
requirements.requirement: Publish reproducible versioned packages, templates, API/event contracts, compatibility tests and private/local registry paths for self-hosters. Certify native/WASM/metadata/service trust separately.

requirements.title: Complete optional app-store purchases, renewals and settlement
requirements.observed: The app store has purchase/license flows, but required card challenges are refused, payouts are manual and invoicing/tax/proration coverage is limited. This is distinct from Commerce subscriptions.
requirements.requirement: Finish customer challenge recovery, invoices/refunds/disputes and publisher settlement only for the commercial store scope; do not block free/internal Ferrum on this optional service.

requirements.title: Review licenses, provenance and third-party obligations per artifact
requirements.observed: The registry has dependency/license inventories and unresolved artifact legal review, not a final legal determination for every distribution.
requirements.requirement: Maintain SBOM/provenance, exact copied/adapted source history, notices and release obligations; obtain qualified review of SDK/plugin distribution terms. Do not infer obligations from a badge.

requirements.title: Add task-based onboarding, shared inboxes and exception workbenches
requirements.observed: The suite provides metadata-driven pages and multiple native interfaces, but complete role-oriented operating experiences are not established by entity counts.
requirements.requirement: Provide industry setup, task help, useful empty states, cross-app navigation, unified approvals/tasks and recovery queues; use capabilities to tailor portal and launcher content.

requirements.title: Turn browser walks into repeatable product acceptance suites
requirements.observed: Many valuable manual browser walks exist, but standing cross-app browser regression coverage is incomplete.
requirements.requirement: Automate ordinary-role happy/negative paths against the exact image; cover permissions, time zones, mobile, reconnect, upgrade and recovery. Keep manual exploratory evidence separate.

requirements.title: Complete human accessibility and localization qualification
requirements.observed: Current Logic includes keyboard/axe/virtual screen-reader evidence and fixes, but no human assistive-technology user review. Arabic/Hindi and RTL exist with unreviewed translations and metadata gaps.
requirements.requirement: Run real assistive-technology task sessions and native-language review; translate domain metadata and content separately; validate numbers/dates, mixed-direction text and complex controls.

requirements.title: Qualify cold-start offline, device retention and recovery
requirements.observed: Lease-based caches and offline work exist, but several cold-start/service-worker/mobile paths were not exercised in the embedded browser used for walkthroughs.
requirements.requirement: Test actual supported browsers/devices, durable pending data, session changes, clock expiry, storage eviction and background synchronization. Distinguish cached reads from unsent business evidence.

requirements.title: Provide reconciled migration and customer exit kits
requirements.observed: Generic import/export and compatibility paths do not by themselves establish a complete business migration.
requirements.requirement: Build source mapping, staged validation, attachments/identity imports, opening balances, stock valuation, open documents, delta cutover and reconciliation with repeatable rollback/exit.

requirements.title: Exercise clean install and disconnected product profiles
requirements.observed: Compose/Kubernetes/offline bundle tooling exists; preflight is partly syntax-checked and a real disconnected install is not established by stand-ins.
requirements.requirement: Run clean-host and actual no-internet installations with exact dependency artifacts, certificate setup, mail/storage/scan/engine checks and actionable doctor output.

requirements.title: Qualify whole-tenant restoration and current policy replay
requirements.observed: Individual database, process and local deployment restore evidence exists; full business state and external effects must be tested together for each supported profile.
requirements.requirement: Restore records, ledgers, files, customizations, keys, process history and integration cursors into isolation; apply current holds/revocations/deletions before releasing effects.

requirements.title: Finish observability, capacity and realistic soak testing
requirements.observed: Request traces/basic metrics and CI workloads exist; complete DB/job/provider spans and business workload sizing are not established.
requirements.requirement: Instrument correlated operations without sensitive data, define profile SLOs, run mixed noisy-tenant/large-dataset/end-of-period workloads and verify alerts with operator response.

requirements.title: Exercise upgrades and artifact-based release governance
requirements.observed: Release evidence and promotion machinery exist; broad registry statements saying workflows never ran are stale. Customizations and open processes complicate safe upgrades.
requirements.requirement: Build once, qualify exact artifacts, require review/checks, publish compatibility/deprecation windows and test previous-to-current upgrades including backfills and schema boundaries.

requirements.title: Make maintenance and support independently operable
requirements.observed: The new Logic maintenance document names one owner for its profiles, with no second owner and no funded LTS commitment. Ownership is present, not absent.
requirements.requirement: Add a second capable maintainer, role-specific runbooks, vulnerability handling and an explicit supported-version commitment. Practice recovery by someone other than the author.

requirements.title: Reconcile stale limits and overlapping requirement registers
requirements.observed: Current records disagree on timers/workflows, company-run authority, retention restrictions, office features and some release execution. New implementation is sometimes hidden by old exclusions.
requirements.requirement: Use capability/profile ownership with supersedes links and exact source/artifact/test evidence. Recheck a claimed missing feature before implementation; never change a status merely to clear the backlog.

acceptance.specification: Reject a save, interrupt the next item, reload the client, reconnect: completion must not be attempted until the rejection is resolved; verify the server independently enforces required work.
Reject a photo or signature, close and reopen the app, and recover the original evidence. A deliberate discard is confirmed and recorded.
Drop the response after a labor/part/expense addition commits; retry after restart and from another tab. Exactly one business effect is retained and both callers get the same receipt.
With a disabled tenant or zero allowance, fail the database policy read; no model request or tool effect is admitted.
Place 5,000 oldest records on hold and eligible unheld records after them. Multiple runs must make progress on the latter without modifying held records. Also exercise permanent delete failures.
Fail merge after field selection: no unreviewed partial merge remains. Retry once, and verify statements, open documents and connector IDs across both identities.
Create a hold, then try UI/API/bulk/native blanking, app uninstall and workspace destruction. Held evidence survives; explicit authorized hold release is a separate recorded action.
A heavy item with no configured weight prevents a capacity-certified dispatch; a measured override is authorized, recorded and reconciled.
One party participates in sales, service, payments and marketing without divergent identity or consent; email changes and merges preserve history and current authority.
The same invalid business action fails through form, REST, import, bulk, MCP, native actions and connector intake; approved native exceptions are explicit and regression-tested.
An operation cannot mix currencies, units, tenants or identifiers accidentally; serialization and migrations retain decimal accuracy and version semantics.
Offboard during an active session, queued notification, open approval, document share and service case; future authority stops and eligible company work goes to its approved successor.
